title: HRDexDB
provider: Lim, Ha et al. 2026 (Seoul National University)
about: Paired human and teleoperated robot grasps of 100 objects on a 21-camera rig; the Allegro V5 Plus and Inspire RH56F1 hands carry tactile sensors, the Inspire RH56DFTP only actuator force readings.

hardware.v: Allegro V5 Plus, Inspire RH56F1, Inspire RH56DFTP, Robotiq 2F-85
hardware.d: Each on an xArm6 · plus a human hand (MANO fit from video, no touch) · touch shown for the three dexterous hands
F1: normal force, tangential force and direction per fingertip and 3 palm pads · DFTP: 6 actuator forces (tactile file empty) · units not stated
2048×1536 · tagged 30 fps (frame times step 30 ms) · 2 views shown
Each robot grasp reproduces a reference human grasp of the same object; success label per sequence

notes: Paper: arXiv 2604.14944. Released under CC BY-NC 4.0 (dataset card); two camera views per sequence are re-encoded to H.264 and hosted here. The paper calls the Allegro and Inspire tactile readings too noisy or sparse to serve as contact labels. Units and the Allegro channel-to-finger order are not documented; the pads are drawn on schematic hands.
